create.purpose: Source-tagged simple-pole witnesses, exact multiplier-order data, punctured/genuine-neighborhood identities and normalized Taylor observations.
Unit-residue and finite-order completion laws; lower-jet vanishing; residual congruence; repeated completion and factorial/binomial normalization.
Holomorphic-germ/Taylor quotient construction; zero ideal equality; pole-carrier to leading-jet isomorphism. Full L2 quotient clauses, not merely its residual corollary.
Contour-norm residue continuity on a common disk and the escaping-tail counterexample with separate convergence/continuation domains.
Finite affine recursion, correction ledger, product/order propagation; raw cancellation control.
Positive horizon schedules; real/complex log comparison; subexponential additive error, positive-part/magnitude rates, extended limsup/liminf, two-sided scale costs.
Accumulated affine budget, cofinal consumer, quotient faithfulness and source-typed finite paths. Native rate hypotheses stay explicit.
Kernel recovery criterion, finite-dimensional range/left-annihilator equivalence and exact distance formula; equivalent observations preserve solution sets.
Ordered factorization counts with positive indices; submultiplicativity, array-surjection square bound, explicit harmonic and square-root sums.
Actual finite-at-horizon translate sums, positive integer indices, gcd-reduced low/high masks, measurable cutoff and integrability interfaces.
Full low-primitive integral bound, both masked Type I estimates, balanced comparison and two-mask regrouping/rate consumer.
Weighted causal L2 holomorphy, all derivative estimates and source-identified continuation/pole incompatibility. Strict half-plane only.
Continuous annihilator and positive distance from actual range closure; functional norm and zero cases treated explicitly.
Bind OPICA to existing physical input/kernel jets, selected right zero, damping, multiplicity and a single GeneratedStep123CompleteOutput. No native nonzero-jet premise.
Construct the original j-drive bounded-causal instance, finite palette compensation and the actual low-mask instance. No higher-source/J5.2/MS1 premise promoted.
H3 linear-involution commutator theorem and zero selfdual projection on the common admissible domain.
Locally finite real signed-measure representation with linear total-variation growth and faithful embedding into tempered distributions. No finite-global-variation shortcut.
Exact sinc-squared/triangle Fourier pair; Gaussian regularization, legitimate signed pairings and lattice Poisson summation needed by H1/H4.
Full signed sharp-gap rigidity and global negative off-lattice mass bound; integer support, periodicity and origin atom.
Convergent Fejer lattice sum, floor formula, exact affine native-completion transform and one-sided cusp derivatives, with analytic domains.
Stable public import surface for H1-H4; no assumed native contact-to-defect construction.
Kernel-checked exact controls for affine cancellation, inverse scale loss, accumulated cost, wrong masks, rank-one/PSD inferences, projection loss and overdetermination.
Normal mathematical public facade. Imported directly as Zeta23.OPICA; not an audit executable and not added to legacy headline root.
Explicit typed consumers covering every required statement clause and the actual same-state native adapters; #check/#print-axiom surface is audit-only, not in the normal facade.
